deep_dive:
Team: Founded 2022 by CEO Michele Stansfield and CFO David Kestenbaum, building on 40 years of continuous-fermentation R&D (acquired IP/assets from predecessor "Agritechnology").
Traction: Operates a 25,000L continuous "hyper-fermentation" facility in Orange, NSW; ran a 10,000L system 8+ months with no contamination/genetic drift; OGTR regulatory approval for animal-protein production trials; partnership with Boston Bioprocess; multiple undisclosed customers committed to scale. No public revenue disclosed.
Investors: Main Sequence Ventures (lead, CSIRO-linked), Horizons Ventures (Li Ka-shing family fund; early Facebook, Spotify, Impossible Foods backer), SOSV (Ginkgo Bioworks, Upside Foods), In-Q-Tel, NGS Super.
Round: Series A2, $13.25M (2026); prior $9.5M AUD Series A (2024). Total raised ~$31.2M/6 rounds.
Sources: greenqueen.com.hk; techcrunch.com (Mar 2026); crunchbase.com.

deep_dive:
CORRECTION FLAG: Isobionics is fully BASF-owned, not independently investable — this changes the investment thesis materially.
Team: Founded 2008 by Toine Janssen (ex-Flexsys VP) at Brightlands/Chemelot Campus, Netherlands. Felix Gard (Head of Specialty Aroma Ingredients) succeeded him as MD 2024-25 post-acquisition.
Traction: Fermentation-based ValencenePure/Nootkatone citrus ingredients; DSM Nutritional Products signed exclusive global distribution deal in 2014. BASF Aroma Ingredients continues launching Isobionics-branded products (2023-2025).
Investors/ownership: Fully acquired by BASF (Sept 2019, undisclosed sum), folded into BASF Care Chemicals/Aroma Ingredients — NOT an independent, VC-investable company. DSM Venturing had an undisclosed minority stake pre-acquisition tied to the 2014 distribution deal.
Round: No independent rounds since BASF acquisition — dead end for direct VC investment.
Sources: basf.com/media/news-releases/2019; brightlandsventurepartners.com; dsm-firmenich.com.

deep_dive:
Team: Copenhagen, founded 2021 — Sotirios Kampranis (Chief R&D, synbio), Simon Dusséaux (CSO, ex-CARBIOS), Victor Forman (CTO, ex-Evolva/Amyris), Jarne Elleholm (Chairman). CEO Camilla Kloss Fenneberg (ex-Coloplast). Board: Flemming Besenbacher (ex-Carlsberg Chairman), Andreas Fibig (ex-IFF Chairman/CEO).
Traction: Yops (yeast-derived hop aroma for low/no-alcohol beer) in industrial production with regulatory approvals; CEO states it's "a profitable product" (Dec 2025). Distribution partnership with Lallemand Brewing (NA/UK/Europe); partnership with flavor major Symrise.
Investors: Symrise, Nordic Foodtech VC, PINC (Paulig venture arm), Thia Ventures, RA Capital's Planetary Health Fund, Newtree Impact, EIFO, Ananke Ventures, The March Group.
Round: €6M (DKK45M), closed Dec 2025, led by RA Capital's Planetary Health Fund. Funds target Asia expansion.

deep_dive:
Team: Founded by Deepak Dugar (CEO) — PhD Chemical Engineering, MIT (lab of Greg Stephanopoulos), MBA/SM MIT, dual-degree IIT Delhi. Incubated via Activate fellowship at Lawrence Berkeley National Lab starting 2014.
Traction: Partnerships with Ginkgo Bioworks (strain engineering for bio-isoprene/SAF, Apr 2023), Goodyear (biobased isoprene for tires), Zeon Corporation (commercializing bio-isoprene/SAF). US Dept. of War Distributed Bioindustrial Manufacturing Program: $2.86M expansion award, citing "line of sight to alpha commercial customer" for a non-toxic solvent. No disclosed revenue.
Investors: Seed led by BlueYard Capital; joined by Zeon Ventures, Global Brain, First Bight Ventures, Acequia Capital. Pre-seed: Cantos Ventures, Creative Ventures, Incite Ventures.
Round: $8M total raised (seed, reported Jan 2023) plus non-dilutive grants ($2.25M DoD Jul 2024, $2.86M DoW DBIMP by Feb 2026). No Series A found — note: below the mandate's Series A/B stage filter.
Sources: visolisbio.com; forbes.com/sites/johncumbers/2023/01/11; synbiobeta.com; cen.acs.org.
